{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "VCE",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The report states that Tank 409 overflowed, gasoline 'formed a vapor cloud,' and at 12:23 a.m. 'the vapor cloud exploded, creating a pressure wave that damaged hundreds of homes and businesses up to 1.25 miles from the site.' The root cause section also identifies the physical cause as gasoline overflow resulting in 'a vapor cloud formation' that 'ignited in the WWT area.'",
      "explanation": "The central accident mechanism analyzed is a large gasoline vapor cloud formed by tank overfill, migrated across the site, and then exploded. The subsequent fires and secondary tank explosions are described as escalation effects, but the report's main causal analysis focuses on the vapor cloud explosion.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "gasoline",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "nearly 200,000 gallons of gasoline",
      "explanation": "Gasoline was the released flammable material that formed the vapor cloud and drove the explosion scenario.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "Tank 409",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "Tank 409 began to overflow.",
      "explanation": "Tank 409 was the storage tank that overfilled and released gasoline.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "wastewater treatment (WWT) area",
      "node_id": "En3",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "recorded the ignition of the vapor cloud in the WWT area",
      "explanation": "The vapor cloud ignited in the wastewater treatment area after migrating from the tank farm.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Vapor",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "forming a large vapor cloud",
      "explanation": "The hazardous state driving the VCE was a gasoline vapor cloud.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report does not explicitly state the pressure condition using the schema categories.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "Atmospheric temperature",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "With a light breeze of about 5 mph on a 79ºF night",
      "explanation": "The release and dispersion occurred under ambient outdoor nighttime temperature conditions.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "High volatility",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "escaped gasoline formed a low-lying vapor cloud",
      "explanation": "The gasoline readily vaporized and formed a large flammable vapor cloud.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Combustible",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "The vapor cloud ignited in the WWT area",
      "explanation": "The released gasoline vapor was flammable and ignited, producing the explosion and fires.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "ToxicSubstance",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "Toxic properties were not identified as a defining condition for this accident scenario in the report.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Asphyxiant",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report does not describe the material in this scenario using asphyxiant properties.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Conductivity",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C8",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report does not specify the electrical conductivity of the gasoline in this incident description.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Continuous release",
      "node_id": "C9",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "Tank 409 overflowed for an estimated 26 minutes before the vapor cloud ignited",
      "explanation": "The gasoline release occurred over several minutes as an ongoing tank overflow rather than as an instantaneous release.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Low confinement",
      "node_id": "C10",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "formed a low-lying vapor cloud that encompassed an area equivalent to 107 acres",
      "explanation": "The vapor cloud spread across large outdoor tank farm and wastewater treatment areas, indicating low confinement.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Dispersed",
      "node_id": "C11",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "formed a low-lying vapor cloud that encompassed an area equivalent to 107 acres",
      "explanation": "The released gasoline dispersed widely as a vapor cloud before ignition.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Tank 409 overfill during gasoline transfer",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "Tank 409 began to overflow.",
      "explanation": "The accident sequence began when Tank 409 overfilled during ship-to-shore gasoline transfer.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "MechanicalFailure",
      "name": "Tank 409 side gauge malfunction",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "Malfunctioning tank side gauge during filling operations that led to inaccurate tank levels being recorded",
      "explanation": "The malfunctioning side gauge was the key equipment failure identified as contributing to the overfill and subsequent loss of containment.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "IgnitionSource",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "Ev3",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "The CSB did not determine the exact source of the ignition",
      "explanation": "The report identifies multiple potential ignition sources in the WWT area, but the exact source was not determined.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
